rationale: The original short thesis relied on a rejection of the 5-minute 9-EMA ($163.13) and a break below consolidation highs ($163.29), both of which have now been breached to the upside as price climbed steadily across the last three 1-minute candles to $163.36. However, flipping long is not justified given the strong intraday downtrend (-3.94% gap on 4.27x relative volume), price remaining well below session VWAP ($164.92), and a heavily weak broader market (SPY -1.58%). Closing the position cuts the loss ahead of the hard stop at $163.55 once the immediate technical setup failed.
